title: GPT tool-use search repair candidate
description: Candidate input, not a trained policy or RL result. Acceptance uses a preference/constraint vector and independent critic evidence; there is no scalar artistic reward.

parent.description: Existing revision or null for a root. Missing parents and duplicate revisions/payloads are refused.

train_eligible.description: Explicit collection flag, never an instruction to train. Effective eligibility also requires acceptance. Synthetic fixtures are never training evidence.

verdict.description: Primary quality bar. A measurement or identity proxy cannot supply this judgment.

x-ledger.format: One canonical JSON envelope per line: sequence, previous_hash, input, decision, id.
x-ledger.id: SHA-256 of canonical envelope excluding id. Genesis previous_hash is 64 zeroes.
x-ledger.integrity: Append-only implementation with file locking, hash verification and branch history. Keep external trusted hashes to detect complete replacement.
semantic_checks: Playback before and after references must differ.
Every parent must precede its child.
Evidence reference strings are not authenticated or opened by the CLI.

x-selection.rejected: Source event false, drawing identity false, failed hard constraint, or reject_source action.
x-selection.milestone_needs_review: Unknown preservation/constraint, missing independent critic, unmet/uncertain primary quality bar, or missing playback evidence for motion claims.
x-selection.accepted: Both preservation flags true, independent critic bar_met, all hard constraints pass, and motion claims include playback scope plus compared before/after/source playback references.
x-selection.tie_rule: Latest recorded accepted candidate. No claim of artistic superiority.
x-selection.terminal_preference: A real terminal motion preference requires independent compared playback of before, after and source. A self-report or single-frame similarity is insufficient. Independent judgments require provenance verification outside this CLI.

x-unexecuted-rl-plan.status: Proposal only. This repository performs GPT tool-use search; no policy, weights, reward model, or RL training has run.
x-unexecuted-rl-plan.episode: State includes source identity/interval, current artifacts, observations and evidence; action is one repair operation; next state includes immutable after-artifact references; terminal preference comes from independent compared playback.
x-unexecuted-rl-plan.warmstart: Imitation warmstart from licensed real successful repair traces, excluding synthetic audit fixtures.
x-unexecuted-rl-plan.offline: Collect pairwise independent playback preferences and constraint labels; evaluate an offline preference model with uncertainty and anti-proxy counterfactuals before policy optimization.
x-unexecuted-rl-plan.online: Budgeted online rollouts with independent review, logged behavior-policy probabilities when available, replayable evidence, and constrained policy updates only after held-out validation.
x-unexecuted-rl-plan.held_out: Split by source identity AND drawing identity, not frames from the same clip. Evaluate frozen, reversed-event, photo-copy, tiny-no-motion and missing-playback counterfactuals.
x-unexecuted-rl-plan.reward: Retain the preference/constraint vector. Do not invent numeric artistic certainty or let identity/similarity/motion magnitude alone become a terminal scalar reward. Any later numeric learning objective requires an explicit independently validated design.
